R/ CERE[S AVGV]STA ; D/ [TI CLAVD]IVS CAESAR AVG PM TR P [IMP...]

A Roman copper alloy dupondius of Claudius dating to AD41 - AD50 (Reece Period 2). Reverse legend reads CERE[S AVGV]STA. Reverse shows Ceres veiled and draped seated left on ornamental throne holding two corn ears and a long torch. Mint of Rome. Ref: RIC I p. 127 no. 94 or p. 129 no. 110. Obverse legend reads [TI CLAVD]IVS CAESAR AVG PM TR P [IMP...]. Obverse shows bare head, left. Reverse fields…
